title: Guest Wi-Fi (QR popup)
description: Tapping the network icon at the top right of the fridge shows a QR code that joins this network. The password is shown on the fridge by design, so it is not stored as a secret, only masked in this form. Leave SSID empty to use GUEST_WIFI_SSID and GUEST_WIFI_PASSWORD from config.env. Any characters are fine; they are escaped for the QR code.

showPassword.title: Show the password under the QR code
